content.intro: This lesson covers Calculated Fields, Items, and Measures as part of PivotTables and PivotCharts. It follows the attached Excel curriculum, with an emphasis on small examples and verification.
content.why_it_matters: Calculated Fields, Items, and Measures supports repeatable analysis by organizing, cleaning, summarizing, or relating data. Preserve the raw source and reconcile a summary back to its input records. Compatibility: Power Query, the Data Model, Power Pivot and DAX are related but distinct capabilities; their exact availability varies by Excel edition, operating system, license and update channel. Follow the course’s local availability checklist before building a dependent workflow.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Calculated Fields, Items, and Measures focuses on the following parts of the supplied syllabus: Calculated fields in conventional PivotTables; When formulas should be calculated in the source data; Data Model measures; Version-specific modeling limitations. Keep the underlying source data visible and make each assumption explicit.
